titleEn: U.S. Patent Act (35 U.S.C., selected sections)
enLabel: 英文原文（美国众议院法律修订办公室）
zhLabel: 中文为 Claude 译，仅供学习
note: 英文为官方现行文本。中文是 Claude 按国内实务通行译法翻译的学习译文，不是官方译本。21 U.S.C. §355 取自 2024 年版。

units.title: Definitions
units.group: 第二部分 可专利性

paras.en: When used in this title unless the context otherwise indicates—
paras.zh: 在本编中，除上下文另有所指外——

paras.en: The term “invention” means invention or discovery.
paras.zh: （a）“发明”一词，指发明或者发现。

paras.en: The term “process” means process, art or method, and includes a new use of a known process, machine, manufacture, composition of matter, or material.
paras.zh: （b）“方法”一词，指方法、技艺或者手段，包括已知方法、机器、制品、物质组合物或者材料的新用途。

paras.en: The terms “United States” and “this country” mean the United States of America, its territories and possessions.
paras.zh: （c）“美国”和“本国”，指美利坚合众国及其领地和属地。

paras.en: The word “patentee” includes not only the patentee to whom the patent was issued but also the successors in title to the patentee.
paras.zh: （d）“专利权人”一词，不仅包括被授予专利的专利权人，也包括专利权人的权利继受人。

paras.en: The term “third-party requester” means a person requesting ex parte reexamination under section 302 who is not the patent owner.
paras.zh: （e）“第三方请求人”一词，指依第 302 条请求单方再审查、但并非专利所有人的人。

paras.en: The term “inventor” means the individual or, if a joint invention, the individuals collectively who invented or discovered the subject matter of the invention.
paras.zh: （f）“发明人”一词，指发明或者发现该发明主题的个人；如为共同发明，指共同发明或者发现该主题的全体个人。

paras.en: The terms “joint inventor” and “coinventor” mean any 1 of the individuals who invented or discovered the subject matter of a joint invention.
paras.zh: （g）“共同发明人”一词，指共同发明中发明或者发现该发明主题的任何一人。

paras.en: The term “joint research agreement” means a written contract, grant, or cooperative agreement entered into by 2 or more persons or entities for the performance of experimental, developmental, or research work in the field of the claimed invention.
paras.zh: （h）“联合研究协议”一词，指两个或者两个以上的人或者实体为在要求保护的发明所属领域开展实验、开发或者研究工作而订立的书面合同、资助协议或者合作协议。

paras.en: The term “effective filing date” for a claimed invention in a patent or application for patent means—
paras.zh: （1）专利或者专利申请中要求保护的发明的“有效申请日”，是指——

paras.en: if subparagraph (B) does not apply, the actual filing date of the patent or the application for the patent containing a claim to the invention; or
paras.zh: （A）不适用（B）项时，包含该发明权利要求的专利或者专利申请的实际申请日；或者

paras.en: the filing date of the earliest application for which the patent or application is entitled, as to such invention, to a right of priority under section 119, 365(a), 365(b), 386(a), or 386(b) or to the benefit of an earlier filing date under section 120, 121, 365(c), or 386(c).
paras.zh: （B）就该发明而言，该专利或者申请依第 119 条、第 365 条（a）（b）款、第 386 条（a）（b）款享有优先权，或者依第 120 条、第 121 条、第 365 条（c）款、第 386 条（c）款享有在先申请日利益的最早一件申请的申请日。

paras.en: The effective filing date for a claimed invention in an application for reissue or reissued patent shall be determined by deeming the claim to the invention to have been contained in the patent for which reissue was sought.
paras.zh: （2）再颁申请或者再颁专利中要求保护的发明，其有效申请日的确定，视为该发明的权利要求已包含在请求再颁的原专利中。

paras.en: The term “claimed invention” means the subject matter defined by a claim in a patent or an application for a patent.
paras.zh: （j）“要求保护的发明”一词，指专利或者专利申请中某项权利要求所限定的主题。

units.title: Inventions patentable
units.group: 第二部分 可专利性

paras.en: Whoever invents or discovers any new and useful process, machine, manufacture, or composition of matter, or any new and useful improvement thereof, may obtain a patent therefor, subject to the conditions and requirements of this title.
paras.zh: 凡发明或者发现任何新颖而有用的方法、机器、制品或者物质组合物，或者对其作出任何新颖而有用的改进者，均可依本编规定的条件和要求获得专利。

explain.en: The text is broad; the limits come from three judicial exceptions: laws of nature, natural phenomena and abstract ideas. Mayo (diagnostics) and Myriad (isolated DNA) are the key pharma cases.
explain.zh: 条文本身很宽：方法、机器、制品、物质组合物都可以申请专利。限制来自判例确立的三项司法例外：自然规律、自然现象、抽象概念。医药领域最相关的判例是 Mayo（诊断方法）和 Myriad（分离的天然 DNA）。

explain.en: Compare China Art. 25: the US does not exclude treatment methods, but diagnostic methods often fail as laws of nature; China expressly excludes diagnosis and treatment methods.
explain.zh: 和中国第二十五条比较：美国不排除治疗方法，但诊断方法常因“自然规律”被否定；中国直接排除“疾病的诊断和治疗方法”。

units.title: Conditions for patentability; novelty
units.group: 第二部分 可专利性

paras.en: Novelty; Prior Art.— A person shall be entitled to a patent unless—
paras.zh: （a）新颖性；现有技术。——有下列情形之一的，申请人不得获得专利：

paras.en: the claimed invention was patented, described in a printed publication, or in public use, on sale, or otherwise available to the public before the effective filing date of the claimed invention; or
paras.zh: （1）要求保护的发明在其有效申请日之前已被授予专利、已在印刷出版物中描述、已公开使用、已销售或者以其他方式为公众所能获得；或者

paras.en: the claimed invention was described in a patent issued under section 151, or in an application for patent published or deemed published under section 122(b), in which the patent or application, as the case may be, names another inventor and was effectively filed before the effective filing date of the claimed invention.
paras.zh: （2）要求保护的发明已在依第 151 条授予的专利中，或者在依第 122 条（b）款公布或者视为公布的专利申请中有所描述，而该专利或者申请（视情况而定）载明的是另一发明人，且其有效申请日早于要求保护的发明的有效申请日。

paras.en: Exceptions.—

Disclosures made 1 year or less before the effective filing date of the claimed invention.— A disclosure made 1 year or less before the effective filing date of a claimed invention shall not be prior art to the claimed invention under subsection (a)(1) if—
paras.zh: （1）在有效申请日前 1 年以内作出的公开。——在要求保护的发明的有效申请日前 1 年以内作出的公开，有下列情形之一的，不构成第（a）（1）项所称的现有技术：

paras.en: the disclosure was made by the inventor or joint inventor or by another who obtained the subject matter disclosed directly or indirectly from the inventor or a joint inventor; or
paras.zh: （A）该公开系由发明人、共同发明人，或者直接或间接从发明人或共同发明人处获得所公开主题的他人作出；或者

paras.en: the subject matter disclosed had, before such disclosure, been publicly disclosed by the inventor or a joint inventor or another who obtained the subject matter disclosed directly or indirectly from the inventor or a joint inventor.
paras.zh: （B）在该公开之前，所公开的主题已由发明人、共同发明人，或者直接或间接从发明人或共同发明人处获得该主题的他人公开披露。

paras.en: Disclosures appearing in applications and patents.— A disclosure shall not be prior art to a claimed invention under subsection (a)(2) if—
paras.zh: （2）专利申请和专利中的公开。——有下列情形之一的，某一公开不构成第（a）（2）项所称的现有技术：

paras.en: the subject matter disclosed was obtained directly or indirectly from the inventor or a joint inventor;
paras.zh: （A）所公开的主题系直接或间接从发明人或共同发明人处获得；

paras.en: the subject matter disclosed had, before such subject matter was effectively filed under subsection (a)(2), been publicly disclosed by the inventor or a joint inventor or another who obtained the subject matter disclosed directly or indirectly from the inventor or a joint inventor; or
paras.zh: （B）在所公开的主题依第（a）（2）项有效提出申请之前，该主题已由发明人、共同发明人，或者直接或间接从发明人或共同发明人处获得该主题的他人公开披露；或者

paras.en: the subject matter disclosed and the claimed invention, not later than the effective filing date of the claimed invention, were owned by the same person or subject to an obligation of assignment to the same person.
paras.zh: （C）不晚于要求保护的发明的有效申请日，所公开的主题与要求保护的发明归同一人所有，或者负有转让给同一人的义务。

paras.en: Common Ownership Under Joint Research Agreements.— Subject matter disclosed and a claimed invention shall be deemed to have been owned by the same person or subject to an obligation of assignment to the same person in applying the provisions of subsection (b)(2)(C) if—
paras.zh: （c）联合研究协议下的共同所有。——适用第（b）（2）（C）项时，符合下列条件的，所公开的主题与要求保护的发明视为归同一人所有或者负有转让给同一人的义务：

paras.en: the subject matter disclosed was developed and the claimed invention was made by, or on behalf of, 1 or more parties to a joint research agreement that was in effect on or before the effective filing date of the claimed invention;
paras.zh: （1）所公开的主题由一项联合研究协议的一方或者多方开发，要求保护的发明由该方或者多方完成（或者以其名义完成），且该联合研究协议在要求保护的发明的有效申请日当日或者之前已经生效；

paras.en: the claimed invention was made as a result of activities undertaken within the scope of the joint research agreement; and
paras.zh: （2）要求保护的发明是在该联合研究协议范围内开展活动的结果；并且

paras.en: the application for patent for the claimed invention discloses or is amended to disclose the names of the parties to the joint research agreement.
paras.zh: （3）要求保护的发明的专利申请披露或者经修改后披露了该联合研究协议各方的名称。

paras.en: Patents and Published Applications Effective as Prior Art.— For purposes of determining whether a patent or application for patent is prior art to a claimed invention under subsection (a)(2), such patent or application shall be considered to have been effectively filed, with respect to any subject matter described in the patent or application—
paras.zh: （d）作为现有技术有效的专利和公布的申请。——为判断某一专利或者专利申请是否构成第（a）（2）项所称的现有技术，对于该专利或者申请中描述的任何主题，该专利或者申请的有效申请时间为——

paras.en: if paragraph (2) does not apply, as of the actual filing date of the patent or the application for patent; or
paras.zh: （1）不适用第（2）项时，为该专利或者专利申请的实际申请日；或者

paras.en: if the patent or application for patent is entitled to claim a right of priority under section 119, 365(a), 365(b), 386(a), or 386(b), or to claim the benefit of an earlier filing date under section 120, 121, 365(c), or 386(c), based upon 1 or more prior filed applications for patent, as of the filing date of the earliest such application that describes the subject matter.
paras.zh: （2）该专利或者专利申请基于一件或者多件在先专利申请，有权依第 119 条、第 365 条（a）（b）款、第 386 条（a）（b）款要求优先权，或者有权依第 120 条、第 121 条、第 365 条（c）款、第 386 条（c）款要求在先申请日利益的，为描述该主题的最早一件此类申请的申请日。

explain.en: After the AIA (2011) the US is first-inventor-to-file; the reference date is the effective filing date (§100(i)) and prior art is worldwide.
explain.zh: AIA（2011 年《美国发明法案》）之后，美国改为“发明人先申请制”。判断时点是“有效申请日”（§100(i)），现有技术不分国内外。

explain.en: The one-year grace period in §102(b)(1) covers any disclosure by the inventor; China allows six months for four statutory situations only (Art. 24).
explain.zh: §102(b)(1) 的一年宽限期覆盖发明人自己的任何公开；中国只有六个月，而且只限四种法定情形（专利法第二十四条）。

units.title: Conditions for patentability; non-obvious subject matter
units.group: 第二部分 可专利性

paras.en: A patent for a claimed invention may not be obtained, notwithstanding that the claimed invention is not identically disclosed as set forth in section 102, if the differences between the claimed invention and the prior art are such that the claimed invention as a whole would have been obvious before the effective filing date of the claimed invention to a person having ordinary skill in the art to which the claimed invention pertains. Patentability shall not be negated by the manner in which the invention was made.
paras.zh: 要求保护的发明，即使未如第 102 条所述被完全相同地公开，但如果要求保护的发明与现有技术之间的区别使得该发明作为一个整体，在其有效申请日之前对于该发明所属领域的普通技术人员是显而易见的，则不得获得专利。可专利性不因作出发明的方式而被否定。

explain.en: Obviousness follows the Graham factors (scope and content of the prior art, differences, level of ordinary skill, and objective indicia such as commercial success). KSR (2007) requires a flexible inquiry rather than a rigid teaching-suggestion-motivation test.
explain.zh: 非显而易见性按 Graham 案确立的因素判断：现有技术的范围和内容、与权利要求的区别、本领域普通技术水平，以及商业成功、长期需求等“客观指标”（又称次要考虑因素）。KSR（2007）强调判断应当灵活，不能僵化地要求现有技术中有明确的“教导—启示—动机”（TSM）。

explain.en: Compound cases often use lead-compound analysis (Takeda v. Alphapharm, 2007): would a skilled person select a prior-art compound as a starting point and have reason to make the specific modification?
explain.zh: 化合物案件常用“先导化合物”分析（Takeda v. Alphapharm, 2007）：本领域技术人员是否会选择某个现有化合物作为改进起点，又是否有理由作出特定修饰。

units.title: Specification
units.group: 第二部分 可专利性

paras.en: In General.— The specification shall contain a written description of the invention, and of the manner and process of making and using it, in such full, clear, concise, and exact terms as to enable any person skilled in the art to which it pertains, or with which it is most nearly connected, to make and use the same, and shall set forth the best mode contemplated by the inventor or joint inventor of carrying out the invention.
paras.zh: （a）总则。——说明书应当对发明以及制造和使用该发明的方式和过程作出书面描述，其用语应当完整、清楚、简明和确切，足以使该发明所属领域或者与之最密切相关领域的任何技术人员能够制造和使用该发明；并应当写明发明人或者共同发明人所设想的实施该发明的最佳方式。

paras.en: Conclusion.— The specification shall conclude with one or more claims particularly pointing out and distinctly claiming the subject matter which the inventor or a joint inventor regards as the invention.
paras.zh: （b）结论。——说明书应当以一项或者多项权利要求作为结尾，权利要求应当具体指出并清楚地要求保护发明人或者共同发明人视为其发明的主题。

paras.en: Form.— A claim may be written in independent or, if the nature of the case admits, in dependent or multiple dependent form.
paras.zh: （c）形式。——权利要求可以写成独立形式；案情性质允许的，也可以写成从属形式或者多项从属形式。

paras.en: Reference in Dependent Forms.— Subject to subsection (e), a claim in dependent form shall contain a reference to a claim previously set forth and then specify a further limitation of the subject matter claimed. A claim in dependent form shall be construed to incorporate by reference all the limitations of the claim to which it refers.
paras.zh: （d）从属形式中的引用。——除第（e）款另有规定外，从属形式的权利要求应当引用在前的一项权利要求，然后对所要求保护的主题作进一步限定。从属形式的权利要求应当解释为通过引用包含了其所引用的权利要求的全部限定。

paras.en: Reference in Multiple Dependent Form.— A claim in multiple dependent form shall contain a reference, in the alternative only, to more than one claim previously set forth and then specify a further limitation of the subject matter claimed. A multiple dependent claim shall not serve as a basis for any other multiple dependent claim. A multiple dependent claim shall be construed to incorporate by reference all the limitations of the particular claim in relation to which it is being considered.
paras.zh: （e）多项从属形式中的引用。——多项从属形式的权利要求应当以择一方式引用在前的一项以上权利要求，然后对所要求保护的主题作进一步限定。多项从属权利要求不得作为任何其他多项从属权利要求的引用基础。多项从属权利要求应当解释为通过引用包含了在考虑时与其相关的那项权利要求的全部限定。

paras.en: Element in Claim for a Combination.— An element in a claim for a combination may be expressed as a means or step for performing a specified function without the recital of structure, material, or acts in support thereof, and such claim shall be construed to cover the corresponding structure, material, or acts described in the specification and equivalents thereof.
paras.zh: （f）组合权利要求中的要素。——组合权利要求中的要素，可以表述为执行特定功能的手段或者步骤，而不记载支持该功能的结构、材料或者动作；此类权利要求应当解释为涵盖说明书中描述的相应结构、材料或者动作及其等同物。

explain.en: §112(a) contains three separate requirements: written description, enablement and best mode. Ariad (en banc, 2010) confirmed that written description is distinct from enablement.
explain.zh: §112(a) 里有三项相互独立的要求：书面描述（written description）、可实施性（enablement）、最佳方式（best mode）。Ariad（2010，联邦巡回法院全院庭审）确认书面描述是独立于可实施性的要求。

explain.en: Best mode remains a filing requirement, but under §282(b)(3)(A) failure to disclose it is no longer a ground to cancel or invalidate a claim.
explain.zh: 最佳方式仍是申请时的义务，但根据 §282(b)(3)(A)，未披露最佳方式已不能作为撤销专利或者认定专利无效的理由。

explain.en: Amgen v. Sanofi (2023): when a claim covers an entire class (e.g. functionally defined antibodies), the specification must enable the full class, not leave the skilled person to trial and error.
explain.zh: Amgen v. Sanofi（2023）：权利要求要求保护一整类（例如以功能限定的抗体）时，说明书必须使技术人员能够制造和使用这一整类，不能让人“反复试错”。

units.title: Contents and term of patent; provisional rights
units.group: 专利期限与延长

paras.en: Contents.— Every patent shall contain a short title of the invention and a grant to the patentee, his heirs or assigns, of the right to exclude others from making, using, offering for sale, or selling the invention throughout the United States or importing the invention into the United States, and, if the invention is a process, of the right to exclude others from using, offering for sale or selling throughout the United States, or importing into the United States, products made by that process, referring to the specification for the particulars thereof.
paras.zh: （1）内容。——每一项专利应当载明发明的简短名称，并授予专利权人及其继承人或者受让人在美国全境排除他人制造、使用、许诺销售或者销售该发明，或者排除他人向美国进口该发明的权利；发明为方法的，并授予其在美国全境排除他人使用、许诺销售或者销售依该方法制造的产品，或者排除他人向美国进口该产品的权利；具体内容参照说明书。

paras.en: Term.— Subject to the payment of fees under this title, such grant shall be for a term beginning on the date on which the patent issues and ending 20 years from the date on which the application for the patent was filed in the United States or, if the application contains a specific reference to an earlier filed application or applications under section 120, 121, 365(c), or 386(c), from the date on which the earliest such application was filed.
paras.zh: （2）期限。——在依本编缴纳费用的前提下，上述授权的期限自专利授权之日开始，至该专利申请在美国提出之日起满 20 年时终止；申请依第 120 条、第 121 条、第 365 条（c）款或者第 386 条（c）款特别引用一件或者多件在先申请的，自其中最早一件申请的申请日起算。

paras.en: Priority.— Priority under section 119, 365(a), 365(b), 386(a), or 386(b) shall not be taken into account in determining the term of a patent.
paras.zh: （3）优先权。——确定专利期限时，不考虑依第 119 条、第 365 条（a）（b）款或者第 386 条（a）（b）款享有的优先权。

explain.en: Term is twenty years from filing; foreign priority does not count (§154(a)(3)). §154(b) provides patent term adjustment (PTA) for USPTO delays.
explain.zh: 专利期限自申请日起二十年；国外优先权不计入期限起算（§154(a)(3)）。§154(b) 规定专利期调整（PTA），用来补偿 USPTO 造成的审查延误。

units.title: Extension of patent term
units.group: 专利期限与延长

paras.en: The term of a patent which claims a product, a method of using a product, or a method of manufacturing a product shall be extended in accordance with this section from the original expiration date of the patent, which shall include any patent term adjustment granted under section 154(b), if—
paras.zh: （a）要求保护产品、产品使用方法或者产品制造方法的专利，符合下列条件的，其期限应当依照本条自专利原到期日（包括依第 154 条（b）款给予的任何专利期调整）起予以延长：

paras.en: the term of the patent has not expired before an application is submitted under subsection (d)(1) for its extension;
paras.zh: （1）在依第（d）（1）款提交延长申请之前，专利期限尚未届满；

paras.en: the term of the patent has never been extended under subsection (e)(1) of this section;
paras.zh: （2）该专利从未依本条第（e）（1）款延长过期限；

paras.en: an application for extension is submitted by the owner of record of the patent or its agent and in accordance with the requirements of paragraphs (1) through (4) of subsection (d);
paras.zh: （3）延长申请由专利的登记所有人或者其代理人依照第（d）款第（1）项至第（4）项的要求提交；

paras.en: the product has been subject to a regulatory review period before its commercial marketing or use;
paras.zh: （4）该产品在商业销售或者使用前经过了监管审查期；

paras.en: The term of a patent eligible for extension under subsection (a) shall be extended by the time equal to the regulatory review period for the approved product which period occurs after the date the patent is issued, except that—
paras.zh: （c）依第（a）款有资格延长的专利，其期限应当延长相当于专利授权日之后发生的、该获批产品监管审查期的时间，但是——

paras.en: each period of the regulatory review period shall be reduced by any period determined under subsection (d)(2)(B) during which the applicant for the patent extension did not act with due diligence during such period of the regulatory review period;
paras.zh: （1）监管审查期的每一阶段，均应当扣除依第（d）（2）（B）款认定的、专利期延长申请人在该阶段未尽勤勉义务的期间；

paras.en: after any reduction required by paragraph (1), the period of extension shall include only one-half of the time remaining in the periods described in paragraphs (1)(B)(i), (2)(B)(i), (3)(B)(i), (4)(B)(i), and (5)(B)(i) of subsection (g);
paras.zh: （2）经第（1）项扣除后，延长期对第（g）款第（1）（B）（i）、（2）（B）（i）、（3）（B）（i）、（4）（B）（i）、（5）（B）（i）项所述期间，只计入剩余时间的一半；

paras.en: if the period remaining in the term of a patent after the date of the approval of the approved product under the provision of law under which such regulatory review occurred when added to the regulatory review period as revised under paragraphs (1) and (2) exceeds fourteen years, the period of extension shall be reduced so that the total of both such periods does not exceed fourteen years; and
paras.zh: （3）获批产品依其监管审查所依据的法律获得批准之日后专利剩余的期限，加上经第（1）（2）项调整后的监管审查期，超过十四年的，应当缩减延长期，使二者之和不超过十四年；并且

paras.en: in no event shall more than one patent be extended under subsection (e)(1) for the same regulatory review period for any product.
paras.zh: （4）对于任何产品的同一监管审查期，无论如何只能依第（e）（1）款延长一项专利的期限。

paras.en: To obtain an extension of the term of a patent under this section, the owner of record of the patent or its agent shall submit an application to the Director. Except as provided in paragraph (5), such an application may only be submitted within the sixty-day period beginning on the date the product received permission under the provision of law under which the applicable regulatory review period occurred for commercial marketing or use, or in the case of a drug product described in subsection (i), within the sixty-day period beginning on the covered date (as defined in subsection (i)). The application shall contain—
paras.zh: （1）为依本条获得专利期延长，专利的登记所有人或者其代理人应当向局长提交申请。除第（5）项另有规定外，该申请只能在产品依其适用的监管审查期所依据的法律获准商业销售或者使用之日起的六十日内提交；对于第（i）款所述的药品，在涵盖日（定义见第（i）款）起的六十日内提交。申请应当包含——

paras.en: A period determined under any of the preceding paragraphs is subject to the following limitations:
paras.zh: （6）依前述任何一项确定的期间，受下列限制：

paras.en: If the patent involved was issued after the date of the enactment of this section, the period of extension determined on the basis of the regulatory review period determined under any such paragraph may not exceed five years.
paras.zh: （A）所涉专利在本条颁布之日后授权的，基于依前述任何一项确定的监管审查期而确定的延长期，不得超过五年。

explain.en: PTE compensates regulatory review: half of the testing phase plus the full approval phase, capped at five years and at fourteen years of remaining term after approval, one patent per regulatory review period. Only excerpts are included here.
explain.zh: 专利期延长（PTE）补偿药品监管审查占用的时间：试验阶段计一半，审批阶段全额计入，延长不超过五年，药品获批后的剩余专利期加延长期不超过十四年，同一监管审查期只能延长一项专利。这里只收录了第 156 条的节选，完整条文见原文链接。

units.title: Infringement of patent
units.group: 第三部分 侵权与救济

paras.en: Except as otherwise provided in this title, whoever without authority makes, uses, offers to sell, or sells any patented invention, within the United States or imports into the United States any patented invention during the term of the patent therefor, infringes the patent.
paras.zh: （a）除本编另有规定外，任何人未经许可，在专利有效期内于美国境内制造、使用、许诺销售或者销售任何专利发明，或者向美国进口任何专利发明的，即构成侵犯该专利。

paras.en: Whoever actively induces infringement of a patent shall be liable as an infringer.
paras.zh: （b）积极诱导他人侵犯专利的，应当作为侵权人承担责任。

paras.en: Whoever offers to sell or sells within the United States or imports into the United States a component of a patented machine, manufacture, combination or composition, or a material or apparatus for use in practicing a patented process, constituting a material part of the invention, knowing the same to be especially made or especially adapted for use in an infringement of such patent, and not a staple article or commodity of commerce suitable for substantial noninfringing use, shall be liable as a contributory infringer.
paras.zh: （c）在美国境内许诺销售或者销售、或者向美国进口专利机器、制品、组合物或者物质组合物的部件，或者用于实施专利方法的材料或者装置，该部件、材料或者装置构成发明的实质部分，且行为人明知其是为侵犯该专利而专门制造或者专门改造的，并且不是适合实质性非侵权用途的常用物品或者商品的，应当作为帮助侵权人承担责任。

paras.en: No patent owner otherwise entitled to relief for infringement or contributory infringement of a patent shall be denied relief or deemed guilty of misuse or illegal extension of the patent right by reason of his having done one or more of the following: (1) derived revenue from acts which if performed by another without his consent would constitute contributory infringement of the patent; (2) licensed or authorized another to perform acts which if performed without his consent would constitute contributory infringement of the patent; (3) sought to enforce his patent rights against infringement or contributory infringement; (4) refused to license or use any rights to the patent; or (5) conditioned the license of any rights to the patent or the sale of the patented product on the acquisition of a license to rights in another patent or purchase of a separate product, unless, in view of the circumstances, the patent owner has market power in the relevant market for the patent or patented product on which the license or sale is conditioned.
paras.zh: （d）原本有权就专利侵权或者帮助侵权获得救济的专利所有人，不因其实施了下列一项或者多项行为而被拒绝救济，或者被认定构成专利权滥用或者非法扩张专利权：（1）从他人未经其同意实施即构成帮助侵权的行为中取得收入；（2）许可或者授权他人实施未经其同意即构成帮助侵权的行为；（3）寻求针对侵权或者帮助侵权行使其专利权；（4）拒绝许可或者拒绝使用该专利的任何权利；或者（5）以取得另一专利的权利许可或者购买另一单独产品，作为许可该专利任何权利或者销售专利产品的条件；但视情况，专利所有人在以此为条件的专利或者专利产品的相关市场上具有市场力量的除外。

paras.en: It shall not be an act of infringement to make, use, offer to sell, or sell within the United States or import into the United States a patented invention (other than a new animal drug or veterinary biological product (as those terms are used in the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act and the Act of March 4, 1913) which is primarily manufactured using recombinant DNA, recombinant RNA, hybridoma technology, or other processes involving site specific genetic manipulation techniques) solely for uses reasonably related to the development and submission of information under a Federal law which regulates the manufacture, use, or sale of drugs or veterinary biological products.
paras.zh: （1）在美国境内制造、使用、许诺销售或者销售，或者向美国进口专利发明（主要利用重组 DNA、重组 RNA、杂交瘤技术或者其他涉及定点遗传操作技术的工艺制造的新兽药或者兽用生物制品除外——该等术语按《联邦食品、药品和化妆品法》及 1913 年 3 月 4 日法案中的含义使用），仅用于与依照规范药品或者兽用生物制品之制造、使用或者销售的联邦法律开发和提交信息合理相关的用途的，不构成侵权行为。

paras.en: It shall be an act of infringement to submit—
paras.zh: （2）提交下列申请的，构成侵权行为——

paras.en: an application under section 505(j) of the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act or described in section 505(b)(2) of such Act for a drug claimed in a patent or the use of which is claimed in a patent,
paras.zh: （A）就某一专利要求保护的药品或者其用途在专利中受保护的药品，依《联邦食品、药品和化妆品法》第 505 条（j）款提出的申请，或者该法第 505 条（b）（2）款所述的申请，

paras.en: an application under section 512 of such Act or under the Act of March 4, 1913 (21 U.S.C. 151–158) for a drug or veterinary biological product which is not primarily manufactured using recombinant DNA, recombinant RNA, hybridoma technology, or other processes involving site specific genetic manipulation techniques and which is claimed in a patent or the use of which is claimed in a patent, or
paras.zh: （B）就并非主要利用重组 DNA、重组 RNA、杂交瘤技术或者其他涉及定点遗传操作技术的工艺制造、且被专利要求保护或者其用途被专利要求保护的药品或者兽用生物制品，依该法第 512 条或者 1913 年 3 月 4 日法案（《美国法典》第 21 编第 151–158 条）提出的申请，或者

paras.en: with respect to a patent that is identified in the list of patents described in section 351(l)(3) of the Public Health Service Act (including as provided under section 351(l)(7) of such Act), an application seeking approval of a biological product, or
paras.zh: （i）对于列入《公共卫生服务法》第 351 条（l）（3）款所述专利清单（包括依该法第 351 条（l）（7）款列入）的专利，提出的生物制品上市批准申请，或者

paras.en: if the applicant for the application fails to provide the application and information required under section 351(l)(2)(A) of such Act, an application seeking approval of a biological product for a patent that could be identified pursuant to section 351(l)(3)(A)(i) of such Act,
paras.zh: （ii）申请人未提供该法第 351 条（l）（2）（A）款要求的申请资料和信息的，就可依该法第 351 条（l）（3）（A）（i）项列入清单的专利，提出的生物制品上市批准申请，

paras.en: if the purpose of such submission is to obtain approval under such Act to engage in the commercial manufacture, use, or sale of a drug, veterinary biological product, or biological product claimed in a patent or the use of which is claimed in a patent before the expiration of such patent.
paras.zh: 但以提交申请的目的，是在该专利期满前取得该法规定的批准，以从事专利所保护的药品、兽用生物制品或者生物制品（或者其用途受专利保护者）的商业性制造、使用或者销售为限。

paras.en: In any action for patent infringement brought under this section, no injunctive or other relief may be granted which would prohibit the making, using, offering to sell, or selling within the United States or importing into the United States of a patented invention under paragraph (1).
paras.zh: （3）依本条提起的专利侵权诉讼中，不得给予禁止依第（1）项在美国境内制造、使用、许诺销售、销售或者向美国进口专利发明的禁令或者其他救济。

paras.en: For an act of infringement described in paragraph (2)—
paras.zh: （4）对于第（2）项所述的侵权行为——

paras.en: the court shall order the effective date of any approval of the drug or veterinary biological product involved in the infringement to be a date which is not earlier than the date of the expiration of the patent which has been infringed,
paras.zh: （A）法院应当裁定，涉及侵权的药品或者兽用生物制品获得批准的生效日期，不得早于被侵犯专利的期满日；

paras.en: injunctive relief may be granted against an infringer to prevent the commercial manufacture, use, offer to sell, or sale within the United States or importation into the United States of an approved drug, veterinary biological product, or biological product,
paras.zh: （B）可以对侵权人发出禁令，禁止已获批准的药品、兽用生物制品或者生物制品在美国境内的商业性制造、使用、许诺销售、销售或者向美国进口；

paras.en: damages or other monetary relief may be awarded against an infringer only if there has been commercial manufacture, use, offer to sell, or sale within the United States or importation into the United States of an approved drug, veterinary biological product, or biological product, and
paras.zh: （C）只有在已获批准的药品、兽用生物制品或者生物制品发生了在美国境内的商业性制造、使用、许诺销售、销售或者向美国进口时，才可以判令侵权人赔偿损失或者给予其他金钱救济；并且

paras.en: the court shall order a permanent injunction prohibiting any infringement of the patent by the biological product involved in the infringement until a date which is not earlier than the date of the expiration of the patent that has been infringed under paragraph (2)(C), provided the patent is the subject of a final court decision, as defined in section 351(k)(6) of the Public Health Service Act, in an action for infringement of the patent under section 351(l)(6) of such Act, and the biological product has not yet been approved because of section 351(k)(7) of such Act.
paras.zh: （D）如该专利已就依《公共卫生服务法》第 351 条（l）（6）款提起的侵权诉讼取得该法第 351 条（k）（6）款所定义的终局法院判决，且该生物制品因该法第 351 条（k）（7）款尚未获批，法院应当发出永久禁令，在不早于依第（2）（C）项被侵犯专利期满日的日期之前，禁止涉及侵权的生物制品侵犯该专利。

paras.en: The remedies prescribed by subparagraphs (A), (B), (C), and (D) are the only remedies which may be granted by a court for an act of infringement described in paragraph (2), except that a court may award attorney fees under section 285.
paras.zh: 第（A）（B）（C）（D）目规定的救济，是法院对第（2）项所述侵权行为可以给予的全部救济；但法院可以依第 285 条判给律师费。

paras.en: Where a person has filed an application described in paragraph (2) that includes a certification under subsection (b)(2)(A)(iv) or (j)(2)(A)(vii)(IV) of section 505 of the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act (21 U.S.C. 355), and neither the owner of the patent that is the subject of the certification nor the holder of the approved application under subsection (b) of such section for the drug that is claimed by the patent or a use of which is claimed by the patent brought an action for infringement of such patent before the expiration of 45 days after the date on which the notice given under subsection (b)(3) or (j)(2)(B) of such section was received, the courts of the United States shall, to the extent consistent with the Constitution, have subject matter jurisdiction in any action brought by such person under section 2201 of title 28 for a declaratory judgment that such patent is invalid or not infringed.
paras.zh: （5）某人提交的第（2）项所述申请中包含依《联邦食品、药品和化妆品法》（《美国法典》第 21 编第 355 条）第 505 条（b）（2）（A）（iv）目或者（j）（2）（A）（vii）（IV）目作出的声明，而作为声明对象的专利的所有人，以及该专利所保护药品（或其用途受该专利保护）在该条（b）款下的已获批申请的持有人，均未在收到依该条（b）（3）款或者（j）（2）（B）款发出的通知之日起 45 日届满前提起专利侵权诉讼的，美国法院在符合宪法的范围内，对该人依《美国法典》第 28 编第 2201 条提起的请求确认该专利无效或者不侵权的诉讼，具有事物管辖权。

paras.en: Subparagraph (B) applies, in lieu of paragraph (4), in the case of a patent—
paras.zh: （A）对于下列专利，适用（B）目，而不适用第（4）项——

paras.en: that is identified, as applicable, in the list of patents described in section 351(l)(4) of the Public Health Service Act or the lists of patents described in section 351(l)(5)(B) of such Act with respect to a biological product; and
paras.zh: （i）根据情况，已列入《公共卫生服务法》第 351 条（l）（4）款所述专利清单或者第 351 条（l）（5）（B）款所述专利清单、涉及某一生物制品的专利；并且

paras.en: for which an action for infringement of the patent with respect to the biological product—
paras.zh: （ii）就该生物制品针对该专利提起的侵权诉讼——

paras.en: was brought after the expiration of the 30-day period described in subparagraph (A) or (B), as applicable, of section 351(l)(6) of such Act; or
paras.zh: （I）在该法第 351 条（l）（6）款（A）目或者（B）目（视情况而定）所述 30 日期限届满后提起；或者

paras.en: was brought before the expiration of the 30-day period described in subclause (I), but which was dismissed without prejudice or was not prosecuted to judgment in good faith.
paras.zh: （II）在第（I）分目所述 30 日期限届满前提起，但被无损害地驳回，或者未被善意地进行至判决。

paras.en: In an action for infringement of a patent described in subparagraph (A), the sole and exclusive remedy that may be granted by a court, upon a finding that the making, using, offering to sell, selling, or importation into the United States of the biological product that is the subject of the action infringed the patent, shall be a reasonable royalty.
paras.zh: （B）在（A）目所述专利的侵权诉讼中，如认定作为诉讼对象的生物制品的制造、使用、许诺销售、销售或者向美国进口侵犯该专利，法院可以给予的唯一且排他的救济为合理许可费。

paras.en: The owner of a patent that should have been included in the list described in section 351(l)(3)(A) of the Public Health Service Act, including as provided under section 351(l)(7) of such Act for a biological product, but was not timely included in such list, may not bring an action under this section for infringement of the patent with respect to the biological product.
paras.zh: （C）本应列入《公共卫生服务法》第 351 条（l）（3）（A）款所述清单（包括依该法第 351 条（l）（7）款就某一生物制品列入），但未及时列入该清单的专利，其所有人不得就该生物制品依本条提起侵犯该专利的诉讼。

paras.en: Whoever without authority supplies or causes to be supplied in or from the United States all or a substantial portion of the components of a patented invention, where such components are uncombined in whole or in part, in such manner as to actively induce the combination of such components outside of the United States in a manner that would infringe the patent if such combination occurred within the United States, shall be liable as an infringer.
paras.zh: （1）任何人未经许可，在美国境内或者从美国供应或者促使供应专利发明的全部或者大部分部件，而这些部件全部或者部分尚未组合，其供应方式积极诱导在美国境外以如在美国境内组合即会侵犯该专利的方式组合这些部件的，应当作为侵权人承担责任。

paras.en: Whoever without authority supplies or causes to be supplied in or from the United States any component of a patented invention that is especially made or especially adapted for use in the invention and not a staple article or commodity of commerce suitable for substantial noninfringing use, where such component is uncombined in whole or in part, knowing that such component is so made or adapted and intending that such component will be combined outside of the United States in a manner that would infringe the patent if such combination occurred within the United States, shall be liable as an infringer.
paras.zh: （2）任何人未经许可，在美国境内或者从美国供应或者促使供应专利发明的任何部件，该部件系为该发明专门制造或者专门改造，且不是适合实质性非侵权用途的常用物品或者商品，该部件全部或者部分尚未组合，行为人明知该部件系如此制造或者改造，并意图使其在美国境外以如在美国境内组合即会侵犯该专利的方式进行组合的，应当作为侵权人承担责任。

paras.en: Whoever without authority imports into the United States or offers to sell, sells, or uses within the United States a product which is made by a process patented in the United States shall be liable as an infringer, if the importation, offer to sell, sale, or use of the product occurs during the term of such process patent. In an action for infringement of a process patent, no remedy may be granted for infringement on account of the noncommercial use or retail sale of a product unless there is no adequate remedy under this title for infringement on account of the importation or other use, offer to sell, or sale of that product. A product which is made by a patented process will, for purposes of this title, not be considered to be so made after—
paras.zh: （g）任何人未经许可，向美国进口、或者在美国境内许诺销售、销售或者使用依美国专利方法制造的产品，如该进口、许诺销售、销售或者使用发生在该方法专利有效期内的，应当作为侵权人承担责任。在方法专利侵权诉讼中，不得因产品的非商业性使用或者零售而给予救济，但就该产品的进口或者其他使用、许诺销售或者销售所致侵权，依本编得不到充分救济的除外。依专利方法制造的产品，在下列情形之后，就本编而言不再视为依该方法制造：

paras.en: it is materially changed by subsequent processes; or
paras.zh: （1）该产品经后续工艺发生实质性改变；或者

paras.en: it becomes a trivial and nonessential component of another product.
paras.zh: （2）该产品成为另一产品中细微且非必要的组成部分。

paras.en: As used in this section, the term “whoever” includes any State, any instrumentality of a State, and any officer or employee of a State or instrumentality of a State acting in his official capacity. Any State, and any such instrumentality, officer, or employee, shall be subject to the provisions of this title in the same manner and to the same extent as any nongovernmental entity.
paras.zh: （h）本条所称“任何人”，包括任何州、州的任何机构，以及以公务身份行事的州或者州机构的任何官员或者雇员。任何州以及任何此类机构、官员或者雇员，应当与任何非政府实体以同样方式、在同样程度上受本编规定的约束。

paras.en: As used in this section, an “offer for sale” or an “offer to sell” by a person other than the patentee, or any designee of the patentee, is that in which the sale will occur before the expiration of the term of the patent.
paras.zh: （i）本条所称专利权人或其指定人以外的人的“销售要约”或者“许诺销售”，是指销售将在专利期满前发生的要约。

explain.en: (a) direct, (b) induced and (c) contributory infringement. Inducement is common in pharma, e.g. generic labels instructing a patented use.
explain.zh: (a) 直接侵权；(b) 诱导侵权；(c) 帮助侵权。医药领域最常见的是诱导侵权，例如仿制药说明书指导医生按专利用途用药。

explain.en: (e)(1) is the Bolar safe harbor (cf. China Art. 75(5)); (e)(2) makes filing an ANDA or 505(b)(2) application an artificial act of infringement so litigation can happen before launch; (e)(2)(C) and (e)(6) implement the BPCIA patent dance for biosimilars.
explain.zh: (e)(1) 是 Bolar 例外（研究和申报豁免），对应中国专利法第七十五条第（五）项；(e)(2) 把提交 ANDA 或 505(b)(2) 申请拟制为侵权行为，这样诉讼可以在仿制药上市之前进行；(e)(2)(C) 和 (e)(6) 是 BPCIA 下生物类似药“专利舞蹈”的配套规定。

units.title: Presumption of validity; defenses
units.group: 第三部分 侵权与救济

paras.en: In General.— A patent shall be presumed valid. Each claim of a patent (whether in independent, dependent, or multiple dependent form) shall be presumed valid independently of the validity of other claims; dependent or multiple dependent claims shall be presumed valid even though dependent upon an invalid claim. The burden of establishing invalidity of a patent or any claim thereof shall rest on the party asserting such invalidity.
paras.zh: （a）总则。——专利应当推定为有效。专利的每一项权利要求（无论是独立、从属还是多项从属形式）均应当独立于其他权利要求的有效性而推定为有效；从属或者多项从属权利要求即使所从属的权利要求无效，也应当推定为有效。证明专利或者其任何权利要求无效的举证责任，由主张无效的一方承担。

paras.en: Defenses.— The following shall be defenses in any action involving the validity or infringement of a patent and shall be pleaded:
paras.zh: （b）抗辩。——在涉及专利有效性或者侵权的任何诉讼中，下列事项可以作为抗辩，并应当在诉状中提出：

paras.en: Noninfringement, absence of liability for infringement or unenforceability.
paras.zh: （1）不侵权、不承担侵权责任或者专利不可执行。

paras.en: Invalidity of the patent or any claim in suit on any ground specified in part II as a condition for patentability.
paras.zh: （2）专利或者涉诉的任何权利要求因不符合第二部分规定的任何可专利性条件而无效。

paras.en: Invalidity of the patent or any claim in suit for failure to comply with—
paras.zh: （3）专利或者涉诉的任何权利要求因不符合下列规定而无效——

paras.en: any requirement of section 112, except that the failure to disclose the best mode shall not be a basis on which any claim of a patent may be canceled or held invalid or otherwise unenforceable; or
paras.zh: （A）第 112 条的任何要求；但未披露最佳方式，不得作为撤销专利任何权利要求、认定其无效或者不可执行的依据；或者

paras.en: any requirement of section 251.
paras.zh: （B）第 251 条的任何要求。

paras.en: Any other fact or act made a defense by this title.
paras.zh: （4）本编规定可以作为抗辩的其他任何事实或者行为。

paras.en: Notice of Actions; Actions During Extension of Patent Term.— In an action involving the validity or infringement of a patent the party asserting invalidity or noninfringement shall give notice in the pleadings or otherwise in writing to the adverse party at least thirty days before the trial, of the country, number, date, and name of the patentee of any patent, the title, date, and page numbers of any publication to be relied upon as anticipation of the patent in suit or, except in actions in the United States Court of Federal Claims, as showing the state of the art, and the name and address of any person who may be relied upon as the prior inventor or as having prior knowledge of or as having previously used or offered for sale the invention of the patent in suit. In the absence of such notice proof of the said matters may not be made at the trial except on such terms as the court requires. Invalidity of the extension of a patent term or any portion thereof under section 154(b) or 156 because of the material failure—
paras.zh: （c）诉讼通知；专利期延长期间的诉讼。——在涉及专利有效性或者侵权的诉讼中，主张无效或者不侵权的一方，应当至迟在开庭审理前三十日，在诉状中或者以其他书面方式通知对方当事人：拟作为涉诉专利已被预见（或者作为现有技术水平，但美国联邦索赔法院的诉讼除外）的依据的任何专利的国家、专利号、日期和专利权人名称，任何出版物的名称、日期和页码，以及可能作为在先发明人或者事先知悉、在先使用或者许诺销售涉诉专利发明的人的姓名和地址。未作此通知的，除依法院要求的条件外，不得在庭审中证明上述事项。因下列主体严重未遵守第 154 条（b）款或者第 156 条的要求，而导致依该条作出的专利期延长全部或者部分无效的——

paras.en: by the applicant for the extension, or
paras.zh: （1）延长申请人，或者

paras.en: by the Director,

to comply with the requirements of such section shall be a defense in any action involving the infringement of a patent during the period of the extension of its term and shall be pleaded. A due diligence determination under section 156(d)(2) is not subject to review in such an action.
paras.zh: 该无效可以在延长期内发生的专利侵权诉讼中作为抗辩，并应当在诉状中提出。依第 156 条（d）（2）款作出的尽职调查认定，不在此类诉讼中接受审查。

explain.en: Patents are presumed valid. In court, invalidity must be proved by clear and convincing evidence (Microsoft v. i4i, 2011), while in IPR/PGR the petitioner needs only a preponderance (§316(e), §326(e)), one reason defendants turn to the PTAB.
explain.zh: 专利推定有效。最高法院在 Microsoft v. i4i（2011）中认定，在法院主张无效须达到“清楚且有说服力的证据”标准；而在 PTAB 的 IPR/PGR 中，请求人只需达到“优势证据”标准（§316(e)、§326(e)）。这是很多被告选择去 PTAB 的原因。

units.title: Injunction
units.group: 第三部分 侵权与救济

paras.en: The several courts having jurisdiction of cases under this title may grant injunctions in accordance with the principles of equity to prevent the violation of any right secured by patent, on such terms as the court deems reasonable.
paras.zh: 对本编所涉案件有管辖权的各法院，可以依照衡平法原则，按其认为合理的条件发出禁令，防止对专利所保障的任何权利的侵犯。

units.title: Damages
units.group: 第三部分 侵权与救济

paras.en: Upon finding for the claimant the court shall award the claimant damages adequate to compensate for the infringement, but in no event less than a reasonable royalty for the use made of the invention by the infringer, together with interest and costs as fixed by the court. When the damages are not found by a jury, the court shall assess them. In either event the court may increase the damages up to three times the amount found or assessed. Increased damages under this paragraph shall not apply to provisional rights under section 154(d). The court may receive expert testimony as an aid to the determination of damages or of what royalty would be reasonable under the circumstances.
paras.zh: 认定请求人胜诉的，法院应当判给请求人足以弥补侵权所造成损失的赔偿，但无论如何不得低于侵权人使用该发明的合理许可费，并加上法院确定的利息和诉讼费用。损害赔偿未由陪审团认定的，由法院评定。在上述任一情形下，法院均可以将赔偿额提高至认定或者评定数额的三倍。本段规定的增加赔偿不适用于第 154 条（d）款规定的临时权利。法院可以采纳专家证言，以协助确定损害赔偿或者在当时情况下何为合理的许可费。

explain.en: Damages are at least a reasonable royalty; courts may enhance up to three times, under Halo v. Pulse (2016) for egregious wilful conduct. China allows one to five times punitive damages (Art. 71).
explain.zh: 补偿性赔偿不得低于合理许可费；法院可以把赔偿额提高到三倍。何时提高赔偿以 Halo v. Pulse（2016）为准，主要看是否属于恶意、故意的侵权。中国是一到五倍惩罚性赔偿（专利法第七十一条）。

units.title: Attorney fees
units.group: 第三部分 侵权与救济

paras.en: The court in exceptional cases may award reasonable attorney fees to the prevailing party.
paras.zh: 在特殊案件中，法院可以判令向胜诉方支付合理的律师费。

units.title: Time limitation on damages
units.group: 第三部分 侵权与救济

paras.en: Except as otherwise provided by law, no recovery shall be had for any infringement committed more than six years prior to the filing of the complaint or counterclaim for infringement in the action. In the case of claims against the United States Government for use of a patented invention, the period before bringing suit, up to six years, between the date of receipt of a written claim for compensation by the department or agency of the Government having authority to settle such claim, and the date of mailing by the Government of a notice to the claimant that his claim has been denied shall not be counted as part of the period referred to in the preceding paragraph.
paras.zh: 除法律另有规定外，对于在诉讼中提出侵权起诉或者反诉之前六年以上发生的侵权行为，不得获得赔偿。就针对美国政府使用专利发明提出的索赔而言，自有权处理该索赔的政府部门或者机构收到书面赔偿请求之日起，至政府向请求人寄出拒绝通知之日止，在起诉前不超过六年的期间，不计入前段所述期间。

units.title: Inter partes review
units.group: 第 31 章 多方复审（IPR）

paras.en: In General.— Subject to the provisions of this chapter, a person who is not the owner of a patent may file with the Office a petition to institute an inter partes review of the patent. The Director shall establish, by regulation, fees to be paid by the person requesting the review, in such amounts as the Director determines to be reasonable, considering the aggregate costs of the review.
paras.zh: （a）总则。——除本章另有规定外，非专利所有人可以向专利商标局提交请求书，请求对该专利启动多方复审。局长应当以规章确定请求复审的人应缴纳的费用，费用数额由局长在考虑复审总成本后确定为合理的数额。

paras.en: Scope.— A petitioner in an inter partes review may request to cancel as unpatentable 1 or more claims of a patent only on a ground that could be raised under section 102 or 103 and only on the basis of prior art consisting of patents or printed publications.
paras.zh: （b）范围。——多方复审的请求人只能基于第 102 条或者第 103 条下可以提出的理由，并且只能以专利或者印刷出版物构成的现有技术为依据，请求以不具备可专利性为由撤销专利的一项或者多项权利要求。

paras.en: Filing Deadline.— A petition for inter partes review shall be filed after the later of either—
paras.zh: （c）提交期限。——多方复审请求书应当在下列日期中较晚者之后提交——

paras.en: the date that is 9 months after the grant of a patent; or
paras.zh: （1）专利授权之日起满 9 个月之日；或者

paras.en: if a post-grant review is instituted under chapter 32, the date of the termination of such post-grant review.
paras.zh: （2）依第 32 章启动了授权后复审的，该授权后复审终结之日。

explain.en: IPR is limited to §102/§103 grounds on patents and printed publications. Enablement, written description or on-sale/public-use evidence require PGR (within nine months of grant) or litigation.
explain.zh: IPR：只能以第 102 条、第 103 条为理由，证据只能是专利和印刷出版物。可以挑战可实施性、书面描述，或者使用销售、使用类证据的，只有 PGR（授权后九个月内）和法院诉讼。

units.title: Petitions
units.group: 第 31 章 多方复审（IPR）

paras.en: Requirements of Petition.— A petition filed under section 311 may be considered only if—
paras.zh: （a）请求书的要求。——依第 311 条提交的请求书，只有符合下列条件的，才予考虑：

paras.en: the petition is accompanied by payment of the fee established by the Director under section 311;
paras.zh: （1）请求书附有局长依第 311 条确定的费用；

paras.en: the petition identifies all real parties in interest;
paras.zh: （2）请求书写明了全部实际利益方；

paras.en: the petition identifies, in writing and with particularity, each claim challenged, the grounds on which the challenge to each claim is based, and the evidence that supports the grounds for the challenge to each claim, including—
paras.zh: （3）请求书以书面方式具体写明每一项受到挑战的权利要求、挑战每一项权利要求所依据的理由，以及支持每一项挑战理由的证据，包括——

paras.en: copies of patents and printed publications that the petitioner relies upon in support of the petition; and
paras.zh: （A）请求人在请求书中所依据的专利和印刷出版物的副本；以及

paras.en: affidavits or declarations of supporting evidence and opinions, if the petitioner relies on expert opinions;
paras.zh: （B）请求人依赖专家意见的，提供支持性证据和意见的宣誓书或者声明；

paras.en: the petition provides such other information as the Director may require by regulation; and
paras.zh: （4）请求书提供了局长以规章要求的其他信息；并且

paras.en: the petitioner provides copies of any of the documents required under paragraphs (2), (3), and (4) to the patent owner or, if applicable, the designated representative of the patent owner.
paras.zh: （5）请求人已向专利所有人（或者在适用时，向专利所有人指定的代表）提供第（2）（3）（4）项所要求的任何文件的副本。

paras.en: Public Availability.— As soon as practicable after the receipt of a petition under section 311, the Director shall make the petition available to the public.
paras.zh: （b）公开。——局长收到依第 311 条提交的请求书后，应当在切实可行时尽快将请求书向公众公开。

units.title: Preliminary response to petition
units.group: 第 31 章 多方复审（IPR）

paras.en: If an inter partes review petition is filed under section 311, the patent owner shall have the right to file a preliminary response to the petition, within a time period set by the Director, that sets forth reasons why no inter partes review should be instituted based upon the failure of the petition to meet any requirement of this chapter.
paras.zh: 依第 311 条提交多方复审请求书的，专利所有人有权在局长规定的期限内，对请求书提交初步答复，阐明因请求书不符合本章任何要求而不应启动多方复审的理由。

units.title: Institution of inter partes review
units.group: 第 31 章 多方复审（IPR）

paras.en: Threshold.— The Director may not authorize an inter partes review to be instituted unless the Director determines that the information presented in the petition filed under section 311 and any response filed under section 313 shows that there is a reasonable likelihood that the petitioner would prevail with respect to at least 1 of the claims challenged in the petition.
paras.zh: （a）门槛。——除非局长认定，依第 311 条提交的请求书和依第 313 条提交的任何答复所提供的信息表明，请求人至少就请求书中受到挑战的一项权利要求有合理可能胜诉，否则局长不得批准启动多方复审。

paras.en: Timing.— The Director shall determine whether to institute an inter partes review under this chapter pursuant to a petition filed under section 311 within 3 months after—
paras.zh: （b）时限。——局长应当在下列日期后 3 个月内，就是否根据依第 311 条提交的请求书启动本章规定的多方复审作出决定——

paras.en: receiving a preliminary response to the petition under section 313; or
paras.zh: （1）收到依第 313 条对请求书提交的初步答复之日；或者

paras.en: if no such preliminary response is filed, the last date on which such response may be filed.
paras.zh: （2）未提交初步答复的，可以提交该答复的最后一日。

paras.en: Notice.— The Director shall notify the petitioner and patent owner, in writing, of the Director’s determination under subsection (a), and shall make such notice available to the public as soon as is practicable. Such notice shall include the date on which the review shall commence.
paras.zh: （c）通知。——局长应当以书面方式将其依第（a）款作出的决定通知请求人和专利所有人，并应当在切实可行时尽快向公众公开该通知。该通知应当载明复审开始的日期。

paras.en: No Appeal.— The determination by the Director whether to institute an inter partes review under this section shall be final and nonappealable.
paras.zh: （d）不得上诉。——局长依本条就是否启动多方复审作出的决定是终局的，不得上诉。

explain.en: The institution threshold is a reasonable likelihood of prevailing and the decision is nonappealable (§314(d)). Since 20 October 2025 the USPTO Director, consulting at least three PTAB judges, decides institution personally, mostly by summary notices without reasons (per the Director’s memorandum of 17 October 2025 as reported by several law firms).
explain.zh: 立案门槛是“合理可能胜诉”；立案决定不可上诉（§314(d)）。自 2025 年 10 月 20 日起，USPTO 局长在咨询至少三名 PTAB 法官后亲自决定 IPR/PGR 是否立案，多数决定以只写结果、不写理由的简要通知形式发出（资料来源：USPTO 2025 年 10 月 17 日公布的局长备忘录，经多家律所报道）。

units.title: Relation to other proceedings or actions
units.group: 第 31 章 多方复审（IPR）

paras.en: Infringer’s Civil Action.—
paras.zh: （a）侵权人提起的民事诉讼。——

paras.en: Inter partes review barred by civil action.— An inter partes review may not be instituted if, before the date on which the petition for such a review is filed, the petitioner or real party in interest filed a civil action challenging the validity of a claim of the patent.
paras.zh: （1）因民事诉讼而禁止多方复审。——在多方复审请求书提交之日前，请求人或者实际利益方已提起质疑该专利某项权利要求有效性的民事诉讼的，不得启动多方复审。

paras.en: Stay of civil action.— If the petitioner or real party in interest files a civil action challenging the validity of a claim of the patent on or after the date on which the petitioner files a petition for inter partes review of the patent, that civil action shall be automatically stayed until either—
paras.zh: （2）民事诉讼的中止。——请求人或者实际利益方在请求人就该专利提交多方复审请求书之日或者之后，提起质疑该专利某项权利要求有效性的民事诉讼的，该民事诉讼自动中止，直至出现下列情形之一——

paras.en: the patent owner moves the court to lift the stay;
paras.zh: （A）专利所有人申请法院解除中止；

paras.en: the patent owner files a civil action or counterclaim alleging that the petitioner or real party in interest has infringed the patent; or
paras.zh: （B）专利所有人提起民事诉讼或者反诉，主张请求人或者实际利益方侵犯了该专利；或者

paras.en: the petitioner or real party in interest moves the court to dismiss the civil action.
paras.zh: （C）请求人或者实际利益方申请法院驳回该民事诉讼。

paras.en: Treatment of counterclaim.— A counterclaim challenging the validity of a claim of a patent does not constitute a civil action challenging the validity of a claim of a patent for purposes of this subsection.
paras.zh: （3）反诉的处理。——就本款而言，质疑专利某项权利要求有效性的反诉，不构成质疑专利某项权利要求有效性的民事诉讼。

paras.en: Patent Owner’s Action.— An inter partes review may not be instituted if the petition requesting the proceeding is filed more than 1 year after the date on which the petitioner, real party in interest, or privy of the petitioner is served with a complaint alleging infringement of the patent. The time limitation set forth in the preceding sentence shall not apply to a request for joinder under subsection (c).
paras.zh: （b）专利所有人提起的诉讼。——请求人、实际利益方或者请求人的利害关系人被送达指控其侵犯该专利的起诉状之日起超过 1 年才提交请求书的，不得启动多方复审。前句规定的时间限制，不适用于依第（c）款提出的合并请求。

paras.en: Joinder.— If the Director institutes an inter partes review, the Director, in his or her discretion, may join as a party to that inter partes review any person who properly files a petition under section 311 that the Director, after receiving a preliminary response under section 313 or the expiration of the time for filing such a response, determines warrants the institution of an inter partes review under section 314.
paras.zh: （c）合并。——局长启动多方复审的，可以酌情将依第 311 条适当提交请求书、且局长在收到依第 313 条提交的初步答复或者提交答复的期限届满后认定应依第 314 条启动多方复审的任何人，合并为该多方复审的当事人。

paras.en: Multiple Proceedings.— Notwithstanding sections 135(a), 251, and 252, and chapter 30, during the pendency of an inter partes review, if another proceeding or matter involving the patent is before the Office, the Director may determine the manner in which the inter partes review or other proceeding or matter may proceed, including providing for stay, transfer, consolidation, or termination of any such matter or proceeding.
paras.zh: （d）多个程序。——尽管有第 135 条（a）款、第 251 条、第 252 条和第 30 章的规定，在多方复审未决期间，如有涉及该专利的其他程序或者事项正在专利商标局进行，局长可以决定该多方复审或者其他程序、事项的进行方式，包括中止、移转、合并或者终止任何此类事项或者程序。

paras.en: Estoppel.—
paras.zh: （e）禁止反悔。——

paras.en: Proceedings before the office.— The petitioner in an inter partes review of a claim in a patent under this chapter that results in a final written decision under section 318(a), or the real party in interest or privy of the petitioner, may not request or maintain a proceeding before the Office with respect to that claim on any ground that the petitioner raised or reasonably could have raised during that inter partes review.
paras.zh: （1）专利商标局程序。——依本章对专利的某项权利要求进行的多方复审作出了第 318 条（a）款规定的最终书面决定的，该多方复审的请求人，或者请求人的实际利益方或者利害关系人，不得以其在该多方复审中已经提出或者合理地本可以提出的任何理由，就该权利要求在专利商标局请求或者维持任何程序。

paras.en: Civil actions and other proceedings.— The petitioner in an inter partes review of a claim in a patent under this chapter that results in a final written decision under section 318(a), or the real party in interest or privy of the petitioner, may not assert either in a civil action arising in whole or in part under section 1338 of title 28 or in a proceeding before the International Trade Commission under section 337 of the Tariff Act of 1930 that the claim is invalid on any ground that the petitioner raised or reasonably could have raised during that inter partes review.
paras.zh: （2）民事诉讼和其他程序。——依本章对专利的某项权利要求进行的多方复审作出了第 318 条（a）款规定的最终书面决定的，该多方复审的请求人，或者请求人的实际利益方或者利害关系人，不得在全部或者部分依《美国法典》第 28 编第 1338 条产生的民事诉讼中，或者在依《1930 年关税法》第 337 条进行的国际贸易委员会程序中，以其在该多方复审中已经提出或者合理地本可以提出的任何理由，主张该权利要求无效。

explain.en: Two key limits: (b) no IPR if filed more than one year after service of an infringement complaint; (e) after a final written decision the petitioner is estopped in court and the ITC on grounds raised or reasonably could have been raised.
explain.zh: 最重要的两个限制：(b) 被送达侵权起诉状后超过一年，不能再提 IPR；(e) 作出最终书面决定后，请求人对“已经提出或者合理地本可以提出”的理由产生禁止反悔，不能再在法院或 ITC 主张。

units.title: Conduct of inter partes review
units.group: 第 31 章 多方复审（IPR）

paras.en: Regulations.— The Director shall prescribe regulations—
paras.zh: （a）规章。——局长应当制定规章——

paras.en: providing that the file of any proceeding under this chapter shall be made available to the public, except that any petition or document filed with the intent that it be sealed shall, if accompanied by a motion to seal, be treated as sealed pending the outcome of the ruling on the motion;
paras.zh: （1）规定本章所述任何程序的案卷应当向公众公开；但意图密封提交、并附有密封动议的请求书或者文件，在该动议裁定之前应当作为密封文件处理；

paras.en: setting forth the standards for the showing of sufficient grounds to institute a review under section 314(a);
paras.zh: （2）规定依第 314 条（a）款启动复审所需的充分理由的证明标准；

paras.en: establishing procedures for the submission of supplemental information after the petition is filed;
paras.zh: （3）规定请求书提交后提交补充信息的程序；

paras.en: establishing and governing inter partes review under this chapter and the relationship of such review to other proceedings under this title;
paras.zh: （4）建立和管理本章规定的多方复审，以及此类复审与本编所述其他程序之间的关系；

paras.en: setting forth standards and procedures for discovery of relevant evidence, including that such discovery shall be limited to—
paras.zh: （5）规定相关证据开示的标准和程序，包括此类开示应当限于——

paras.en: the deposition of witnesses submitting affidavits or declarations; and
paras.zh: （A）对提交宣誓书或者声明的证人进行取证询问；以及

paras.en: what is otherwise necessary in the interest of justice;
paras.zh: （B）为实现公正而另有必要的事项；

paras.en: prescribing sanctions for abuse of discovery, abuse of process, or any other improper use of the proceeding, such as to harass or to cause unnecessary delay or an unnecessary increase in the cost of the proceeding;
paras.zh: （6）规定对滥用证据开示、滥用程序或者以其他不当方式利用本程序（例如骚扰，或者造成不必要的拖延、不必要地增加程序成本）的制裁；

paras.en: providing for protective orders governing the exchange and submission of confidential information;
paras.zh: （7）规定规范保密信息交换和提交的保护令；

paras.en: providing for the filing by the patent owner of a response to the petition under section 313 after an inter partes review has been instituted, and requiring that the patent owner file with such response, through affidavits or declarations, any additional factual evidence and expert opinions on which the patent owner relies in support of the response;
paras.zh: （8）规定在多方复审启动后，由专利所有人对依第 313 条提交的请求书提交答复，并要求专利所有人在提交答复时，以宣誓书或者声明的方式提交其在答复中所依据的任何补充事实证据和专家意见；

paras.en: setting forth standards and procedures for allowing the patent owner to move to amend the patent under subsection (d) to cancel a challenged claim or propose a reasonable number of substitute claims, and ensuring that any information submitted by the patent owner in support of any amendment entered under subsection (d) is made available to the public as part of the prosecution history of the patent;
paras.zh: （9）规定允许专利所有人依第（d）款申请修改专利、以删除受到挑战的权利要求或者提出合理数量的替代权利要求的标准和程序，并确保专利所有人为支持依第（d）款作出的修改而提交的任何信息，作为专利审查历史的一部分向公众公开；

paras.en: providing either party with the right to an oral hearing as part of the proceeding;
paras.zh: （10）规定任何一方当事人都有权在程序中要求口头审理；

paras.en: requiring that the final determination in an inter partes review be issued not later than 1 year after the date on which the Director notices the institution of a review under this chapter, except that the Director may, for good cause shown, extend the 1-year period by not more than 6 months, and may adjust the time periods in this paragraph in the case of joinder under section 315(c);
paras.zh: （11）要求多方复审的最终决定，不晚于局长通知启动本章规定的复审之日起 1 年作出；但局长有正当理由的，可以将 1 年期限延长不超过 6 个月，并可以在依第 315 条（c）款合并的情况下调整本项规定的期限；

paras.en: setting a time period for requesting joinder under section 315(c); and
paras.zh: （12）规定依第 315 条（c）款请求合并的期限；以及

paras.en: providing the petitioner with at least 1 opportunity to file written comments within a time period established by the Director.
paras.zh: （13）规定请求人在局长确定的期限内至少有 1 次提交书面意见的机会。

paras.en: Considerations.— In prescribing regulations under this section, the Director shall consider the effect of any such regulation on the economy, the integrity of the patent system, the efficient administration of the Office, and the ability of the Office to timely complete proceedings instituted under this chapter.
paras.zh: （b）考虑因素。——局长依本条制定规章时，应当考虑该规章对经济、专利制度的完整性、专利商标局的有效管理，以及专利商标局按时完成依本章启动的程序的能力的影响。

paras.en: Patent Trial and Appeal Board.— The Patent Trial and Appeal Board shall, in accordance with section 6, conduct each inter partes review instituted under this chapter.
paras.zh: （c）专利审判和上诉委员会。——专利审判和上诉委员会应当依照第 6 条，审理依本章启动的每一件多方复审。

paras.en: Amendment of the Patent.—
paras.zh: （d）专利的修改。——

paras.en: In general.— During an inter partes review instituted under this chapter, the patent owner may file 1 motion to amend the patent in 1 or more of the following ways:
paras.zh: （1）总则。——在依本章启动的多方复审期间，专利所有人可以提出 1 项修改专利的动议，以下列一种或者多种方式修改专利：

paras.en: Cancel any challenged patent claim.
paras.zh: （A）删除任何受到挑战的专利权利要求。

paras.en: For each challenged claim, propose a reasonable number of substitute claims.
paras.zh: （B）对每一项受到挑战的权利要求，提出合理数量的替代权利要求。

paras.en: Additional motions.— Additional motions to amend may be permitted upon the joint request of the petitioner and the patent owner to materially advance the settlement of a proceeding under section 317, or as permitted by regulations prescribed by the Director.
paras.zh: （2）追加动议。——为实质性推进依第 317 条进行的程序和解，经请求人和专利所有人共同请求，或者依局长制定的规章的允许，可以准许追加修改动议。

paras.en: Scope of claims.— An amendment under this subsection may not enlarge the scope of the claims of the patent or introduce new matter.
paras.zh: （3）权利要求的范围。——依本款作出的修改，不得扩大专利权利要求的范围，也不得引入新的内容。

paras.en: Evidentiary Standards.— In an inter partes review instituted under this chapter, the petitioner shall have the burden of proving a proposition of unpatentability by a preponderance of the evidence.
paras.zh: （e）证明标准。——在依本章启动的多方复审中，请求人对不具备可专利性的主张负有以优势证据加以证明的责任。

explain.en: Timing: final written decision within one year of institution, extendable by up to six months ((a)(11)); preponderance standard ((e)); one motion to amend that may not broaden claims or add new matter ((d)).
explain.zh: 时限：自立案起一年内作出最终书面决定，有正当理由可延长不超过六个月（(a)(11)）。证明标准为优势证据（(e)）。专利权人可以提出一次修改动议，但不得扩大权利要求范围或引入新内容（(d)）。

units.title: Settlement
units.group: 第 31 章 多方复审（IPR）

paras.en: In General.— An inter partes review instituted under this chapter shall be terminated with respect to any petitioner upon the joint request of the petitioner and the patent owner, unless the Office has decided the merits of the proceeding before the request for termination is filed. If the inter partes review is terminated with respect to a petitioner under this section, no estoppel under section 315(e) shall attach to the petitioner, or to the real party in interest or privy of the petitioner, on the basis of that petitioner’s institution of that inter partes review. If no petitioner remains in the inter partes review, the Office may terminate the review or proceed to a final written decision under section 318(a).
paras.zh: （a）总则。——经请求人和专利所有人共同请求，依本章启动的多方复审对该请求人终止；但专利商标局在提出终止请求前已就程序实体问题作出决定的除外。依本条对某一请求人终止多方复审的，不因该请求人启动了该多方复审，而对该请求人或者其实际利益方、利害关系人适用第 315 条（e）款规定的禁止反悔。多方复审中已无请求人的，专利商标局可以终止复审，也可以继续作出第 318 条（a）款规定的最终书面决定。

paras.en: Agreements in Writing.— Any agreement or understanding between the patent owner and a petitioner, including any collateral agreements referred to in such agreement or understanding, made in connection with, or in contemplation of, the termination of an inter partes review under this section shall be in writing and a true copy of such agreement or understanding shall be filed in the Office before the termination of the inter partes review as between the parties. At the request of a party to the proceeding, the agreement or understanding shall be treated as business confidential information, shall be kept separate from the file of the involved patents, and shall be made available only to Federal Government agencies on written request, or to any person on a showing of good cause.
paras.zh: （b）书面协议。——专利所有人与请求人之间就依本条终止多方复审达成的、或者为此而达成的任何协议或者谅解（包括其中提及的任何附属协议），应当采用书面形式，并应当在当事人之间的多方复审终止前，将该协议或者谅解的真实副本提交专利商标局。经程序一方当事人请求，该协议或者谅解应当作为商业秘密信息处理，与所涉专利的案卷分开保存，并且只有在联邦政府机构书面请求时，或者任何人证明有正当理由时，才向其提供。

units.title: Decision of the Board
units.group: 第 31 章 多方复审（IPR）

paras.en: Final Written Decision.— If an inter partes review is instituted and not dismissed under this chapter, the Patent Trial and Appeal Board shall issue a final written decision with respect to the patentability of any patent claim challenged by the petitioner and any new claim added under section 316(d).
paras.zh: （a）最终书面决定。——依本章启动且未被驳回的多方复审，专利审判和上诉委员会应当就请求人挑战的任何专利权利要求以及依第 316 条（d）款新增的任何权利要求的可专利性，作出最终书面决定。

paras.en: Certificate.— If the Patent Trial and Appeal Board issues a final written decision under subsection (a) and the time for appeal has expired or any appeal has terminated, the Director shall issue and publish a certificate canceling any claim of the patent finally determined to be unpatentable, confirming any claim of the patent determined to be patentable, and incorporating in the patent by operation of the certificate any new or amended claim determined to be patentable.
paras.zh: （b）证书。——专利审判和上诉委员会依第（a）款作出最终书面决定，且上诉期限已经届满或者任何上诉已经终结的，局长应当签发并公布证书，撤销专利中最终被认定不具备可专利性的任何权利要求，确认被认定具备可专利性的任何权利要求，并通过该证书的效力将被认定具备可专利性的任何新的或者经修改的权利要求并入专利。

paras.en: Intervening Rights.— Any proposed amended or new claim determined to be patentable and incorporated into a patent following an inter partes review under this chapter shall have the same effect as that specified in section 252 for reissued patents on the right of any person who made, purchased, or used within the United States, or imported into the United States, anything patented by such proposed amended or new claim, or who made substantial preparation therefor, before the issuance of a certificate under subsection (b).
paras.zh: （c）中间权利。——在依本章进行的多方复审后被认定具备可专利性并并入专利的任何拟修改或者新增的权利要求，对于在依第（b）款签发证书之前，在美国境内制造、购买或者使用，或者向美国进口该拟修改或者新增权利要求所保护的任何物品，或者为此作好实质性准备的任何人的权利，具有第 252 条就再颁专利所规定的同等效力。

paras.en: Data on Length of Review.— The Office shall make available to the public data describing the length of time between the institution of, and the issuance of a final written decision under subsection (a) for, each inter partes review.
paras.zh: （d）复审时长数据。——专利商标局应当向公众公开数据，说明每一件多方复审从启动到依第（a）款作出最终书面决定之间的时长。

units.title: Appeal
units.group: 第 31 章 多方复审（IPR）

paras.en: A party dissatisfied with the final written decision of the Patent Trial and Appeal Board under section 318(a) may appeal the decision pursuant to sections 141 through 144. Any party to the inter partes review shall have the right to be a party to the appeal.
paras.zh: 对专利审判和上诉委员会依第 318 条（a）款作出的最终书面决定不服的当事人，可以依第 141 条至第 144 条对该决定提起上诉。多方复审的任何当事人都有权成为该上诉的当事人。

units.title: Post-grant review
units.group: 第 32 章 授权后复审（PGR）

paras.en: In General.— Subject to the provisions of this chapter, a person who is not the owner of a patent may file with the Office a petition to institute a post-grant review of the patent. The Director shall establish, by regulation, fees to be paid by the person requesting the review, in such amounts as the Director determines to be reasonable, considering the aggregate costs of the post-grant review.
paras.zh: （a）总则。——除本章另有规定外，非专利所有人可以向专利商标局提交请求书，请求对该专利启动授权后复审。局长应当以规章确定请求复审的人应缴纳的费用，费用数额由局长在考虑授权后复审总成本后确定为合理的数额。

paras.en: Scope.— A petitioner in a post-grant review may request to cancel as unpatentable 1 or more claims of a patent on any ground that could be raised under paragraph (2) or (3) of section 282(b) (relating to invalidity of the patent or any claim).
paras.zh: （b）范围。——授权后复审的请求人，可以基于第 282 条（b）款第（2）项或者第（3）项（关于专利或者任何权利要求无效）下可以提出的任何理由，请求以不具备可专利性为由撤销专利的一项或者多项权利要求。

paras.en: Filing Deadline.— A petition for a post-grant review may only be filed not later than the date that is 9 months after the date of the grant of the patent or of the issuance of a reissue patent (as the case may be).
paras.zh: （c）提交期限。——授权后复审请求书只能在专利授权之日或者再颁专利颁发之日（视情况而定）起 9 个月内提交。

explain.en: PGR must be filed within nine months of grant but may raise any invalidity ground under §282(b)(2)–(3), including §101 and §112 — an important window against functional biopharma claims.
explain.zh: PGR 必须在授权后九个月内提出，但可以使用 §282(b)(2)(3) 的任何无效理由，包括 §101、§112。对生物医药专利，这是挑战功能性权利要求的重要窗口。

units.title: Petitions
units.group: 第 32 章 授权后复审（PGR）

paras.en: Requirements of Petition.— A petition filed under section 321 may be considered only if—
paras.zh: （a）请求书的要求。——依第 321 条提交的请求书，只有符合下列条件的，才予考虑：

paras.en: the petition is accompanied by payment of the fee established by the Director under section 321;
paras.zh: （1）请求书附有局长依第 321 条确定的费用；

paras.en: the petition identifies all real parties in interest;
paras.zh: （2）请求书写明了全部实际利益方；

paras.en: the petition identifies, in writing and with particularity, each claim challenged, the grounds on which the challenge to each claim is based, and the evidence that supports the grounds for the challenge to each claim, including—
paras.zh: （3）请求书以书面方式具体写明每一项受到挑战的权利要求、挑战每一项权利要求所依据的理由，以及支持每一项挑战理由的证据，包括——

paras.en: copies of patents and printed publications that the petitioner relies upon in support of the petition; and
paras.zh: （A）请求人在请求书中所依据的专利和印刷出版物的副本；以及

paras.en: affidavits or declarations of supporting evidence and opinions, if the petitioner relies on other factual evidence or on expert opinions;
paras.zh: （B）请求人依赖其他事实证据或者专家意见的，提供支持性证据和意见的宣誓书或者声明；

paras.en: the petition provides such other information as the Director may require by regulation; and
paras.zh: （4）请求书提供了局长以规章要求的其他信息；并且

paras.en: the petitioner provides copies of any of the documents required under paragraphs (2), (3), and (4) to the patent owner or, if applicable, the designated representative of the patent owner.
paras.zh: （5）请求人已向专利所有人（或者在适用时，向专利所有人指定的代表）提供第（2）（3）（4）项所要求的任何文件的副本。

paras.en: Public Availability.— As soon as practicable after the receipt of a petition under section 321, the Director shall make the petition available to the public.
paras.zh: （b）公开。——局长收到依第 321 条提交的请求书后，应当在切实可行时尽快将请求书向公众公开。

units.title: Preliminary response to petition
units.group: 第 32 章 授权后复审（PGR）

paras.en: If a post-grant review petition is filed under section 321, the patent owner shall have the right to file a preliminary response to the petition, within a time period set by the Director, that sets forth reasons why no post-grant review should be instituted based upon the failure of the petition to meet any requirement of this chapter.
paras.zh: 依第 321 条提交授权后复审请求书的，专利所有人有权在局长规定的期限内，对请求书提交初步答复，阐明因请求书不符合本章任何要求而不应启动授权后复审的理由。

units.title: Institution of post-grant review
units.group: 第 32 章 授权后复审（PGR）

paras.en: Threshold.— The Director may not authorize a post-grant review to be instituted unless the Director determines that the information presented in the petition filed under section 321, if such information is not rebutted, would demonstrate that it is more likely than not that at least 1 of the claims challenged in the petition is unpatentable.
paras.zh: （a）门槛。——除非局长认定，依第 321 条提交的请求书所提供的信息如未被反驳，将表明请求书中受到挑战的权利要求至少有一项更有可能不具备可专利性，否则局长不得批准启动授权后复审。

paras.en: Additional Grounds.— The determination required under subsection (a) may also be satisfied by a showing that the petition raises a novel or unsettled legal question that is important to other patents or patent applications.
paras.zh: （b）其他理由。——如果表明请求书提出了对其他专利或者专利申请具有重要意义的新颖或者尚无定论的法律问题，也可以满足第（a）款要求的认定。

paras.en: Timing.— The Director shall determine whether to institute a post-grant review under this chapter pursuant to a petition filed under section 321 within 3 months after—
paras.zh: （c）时限。——局长应当在下列日期后 3 个月内，就是否根据依第 321 条提交的请求书启动本章规定的授权后复审作出决定——

paras.en: receiving a preliminary response to the petition under section 323; or
paras.zh: （1）收到依第 323 条对请求书提交的初步答复之日；或者

paras.en: if no such preliminary response is filed, the last date on which such response may be filed.
paras.zh: （2）未提交初步答复的，可以提交该答复的最后一日。

paras.en: Notice.— The Director shall notify the petitioner and patent owner, in writing, of the Director’s determination under subsection (a) or (b), and shall make such notice available to the public as soon as is practicable. Such notice shall include the date on which the review shall commence.
paras.zh: （d）通知。——局长应当以书面方式将其依第（a）款或者第（b）款作出的决定通知请求人和专利所有人，并应当在切实可行时尽快向公众公开该通知。该通知应当载明复审开始的日期。

paras.en: No Appeal.— The determination by the Director whether to institute a post-grant review under this section shall be final and nonappealable.
paras.zh: （e）不得上诉。——局长依本条就是否启动授权后复审作出的决定是终局的，不得上诉。

units.title: Relation to other proceedings or actions
units.group: 第 32 章 授权后复审（PGR）

paras.en: Infringer’s Civil Action.—
paras.zh: （a）侵权人提起的民事诉讼。——

paras.en: Post-grant review barred by civil action.— A post-grant review may not be instituted under this chapter if, before the date on which the petition for such a review is filed, the petitioner or real party in interest filed a civil action challenging the validity of a claim of the patent.
paras.zh: （1）因民事诉讼而禁止授权后复审。——在授权后复审请求书提交之日前，请求人或者实际利益方已提起质疑该专利某项权利要求有效性的民事诉讼的，不得依本章启动授权后复审。

paras.en: Stay of civil action.— If the petitioner or real party in interest files a civil action challenging the validity of a claim of the patent on or after the date on which the petitioner files a petition for post-grant review of the patent, that civil action shall be automatically stayed until either—
paras.zh: （2）民事诉讼的中止。——请求人或者实际利益方在请求人就该专利提交授权后复审请求书之日或者之后，提起质疑该专利某项权利要求有效性的民事诉讼的，该民事诉讼自动中止，直至出现下列情形之一——

paras.en: the patent owner moves the court to lift the stay;
paras.zh: （A）专利所有人申请法院解除中止；

paras.en: the patent owner files a civil action or counterclaim alleging that the petitioner or real party in interest has infringed the patent; or
paras.zh: （B）专利所有人提起民事诉讼或者反诉，主张请求人或者实际利益方侵犯了该专利；或者

paras.en: the petitioner or real party in interest moves the court to dismiss the civil action.
paras.zh: （C）请求人或者实际利益方申请法院驳回该民事诉讼。

paras.en: Treatment of counterclaim.— A counterclaim challenging the validity of a claim of a patent does not constitute a civil action challenging the validity of a claim of a patent for purposes of this subsection.
paras.zh: （3）反诉的处理。——就本款而言，质疑专利某项权利要求有效性的反诉，不构成质疑专利某项权利要求有效性的民事诉讼。

paras.en: Preliminary Injunctions.— If a civil action alleging infringement of a patent is filed within 3 months after the date on which the patent is granted, the court may not stay its consideration of the patent owner’s motion for a preliminary injunction against infringement of the patent on the basis that a petition for post-grant review has been filed under this chapter or that such a post-grant review has been instituted under this chapter.
paras.zh: （b）诉前禁令。——在专利授权之日起 3 个月内提起专利侵权民事诉讼的，法院不得以已依本章提交授权后复审请求书或者已依本章启动授权后复审为由，中止审理专利所有人针对侵权行为提出的诉前禁令动议。

paras.en: Joinder.— If more than 1 petition for a post-grant review under this chapter is properly filed against the same patent and the Director determines that more than 1 of these petitions warrants the institution of a post-grant review under section 324, the Director may consolidate such reviews into a single post-grant review.
paras.zh: （c）合并。——针对同一专利依本章适当提交了 1 份以上授权后复审请求书，且局长认定其中 1 份以上请求书应依第 324 条启动授权后复审的，局长可以将这些复审合并为一个授权后复审。

paras.en: Multiple Proceedings.— Notwithstanding sections 135(a), 251, and 252, and chapter 30, during the pendency of any post-grant review under this chapter, if another proceeding or matter involving the patent is before the Office, the Director may determine the manner in which the post-grant review or other proceeding or matter may proceed, including providing for the stay, transfer, consolidation, or termination of any such matter or proceeding. In determining whether to institute or order a proceeding under this chapter, chapter 30, or chapter 31, the Director may take into account whether, and reject the petition or request because, the same or substantially the same prior art or arguments previously were presented to the Office.
paras.zh: （d）多个程序。——尽管有第 135 条（a）款、第 251 条、第 252 条和第 30 章的规定，在依本章进行的任何授权后复审未决期间，如有涉及该专利的其他程序或者事项正在专利商标局进行，局长可以决定该授权后复审或者其他程序、事项的进行方式，包括中止、移转、合并或者终止任何此类事项或者程序。局长在决定是否依本章、第 30 章或者第 31 章启动或者命令进行程序时，可以考虑相同或者实质相同的现有技术或者理由此前是否已向专利商标局提出，并可以因此驳回请求书或者请求。

paras.en: Estoppel.—
paras.zh: （e）禁止反悔。——

paras.en: Proceedings before the office.— The petitioner in a post-grant review of a claim in a patent under this chapter that results in a final written decision under section 328(a), or the real party in interest or privy of the petitioner, may not request or maintain a proceeding before the Office with respect to that claim on any ground that the petitioner raised or reasonably could have raised during that post-grant review.
paras.zh: （1）专利商标局程序。——依本章对专利的某项权利要求进行的授权后复审作出了第 328 条（a）款规定的最终书面决定的，该授权后复审的请求人，或者请求人的实际利益方或者利害关系人，不得以其在该授权后复审中已经提出或者合理地本可以提出的任何理由，就该权利要求在专利商标局请求或者维持任何程序。

paras.en: Civil actions and other proceedings.— The petitioner in a post-grant review of a claim in a patent under this chapter that results in a final written decision under section 328(a), or the real party in interest or privy of the petitioner, may not assert either in a civil action arising in whole or in part under section 1338 of title 28 or in a proceeding before the International Trade Commission under section 337 of the Tariff Act of 1930 that the claim is invalid on any ground that the petitioner raised or reasonably could have raised during that post-grant review.
paras.zh: （2）民事诉讼和其他程序。——依本章对专利的某项权利要求进行的授权后复审作出了第 328 条（a）款规定的最终书面决定的，该授权后复审的请求人，或者请求人的实际利益方或者利害关系人，不得在全部或者部分依《美国法典》第 28 编第 1338 条产生的民事诉讼中，或者在依《1930 年关税法》第 337 条进行的国际贸易委员会程序中，以其在该授权后复审中已经提出或者合理地本可以提出的任何理由，主张该权利要求无效。

paras.en: Reissue Patents.— A post-grant review may not be instituted under this chapter if the petition requests cancellation of a claim in a reissue patent that is identical to or narrower than a claim in the original patent from which the reissue patent was issued, and the time limitations in section 321(c) would bar filing a petition for a post-grant review for such original patent.
paras.zh: （f）再颁专利。——请求书请求撤销的是再颁专利中与原专利权利要求相同或者更窄的权利要求，而依第 321 条（c）款规定的期限，已不能对原专利提交授权后复审请求书的，不得依本章启动授权后复审。

units.title: Conduct of post-grant review
units.group: 第 32 章 授权后复审（PGR）

paras.en: Regulations.— The Director shall prescribe regulations—
paras.zh: （a）规章。——局长应当制定规章——

paras.en: providing that the file of any proceeding under this chapter shall be made available to the public, except that any petition or document filed with the intent that it be sealed shall, if accompanied by a motion to seal, be treated as sealed pending the outcome of the ruling on the motion;
paras.zh: （1）规定本章所述任何程序的案卷应当向公众公开；但意图密封提交、并附有密封动议的请求书或者文件，在该动议裁定之前应当作为密封文件处理；

paras.en: setting forth the standards for the showing of sufficient grounds to institute a review under subsections (a) and (b) of section 324;
paras.zh: （2）规定依第 324 条（a）款和（b）款启动复审所需的充分理由的证明标准；

paras.en: establishing procedures for the submission of supplemental information after the petition is filed;
paras.zh: （3）规定请求书提交后提交补充信息的程序；

paras.en: establishing and governing a post-grant review under this chapter and the relationship of such review to other proceedings under this title;
paras.zh: （4）建立和管理本章规定的授权后复审，以及此类复审与本编所述其他程序之间的关系；

paras.en: setting forth standards and procedures for discovery of relevant evidence, including that such discovery shall be limited to evidence directly related to factual assertions advanced by either party in the proceeding;
paras.zh: （5）规定相关证据开示的标准和程序，包括此类开示应当限于与任何一方在程序中提出的事实主张直接相关的证据；

paras.en: prescribing sanctions for abuse of discovery, abuse of process, or any other improper use of the proceeding, such as to harass or to cause unnecessary delay or an unnecessary increase in the cost of the proceeding;
paras.zh: （6）规定对滥用证据开示、滥用程序或者以其他不当方式利用本程序（例如骚扰，或者造成不必要的拖延、不必要地增加程序成本）的制裁；

paras.en: providing for protective orders governing the exchange and submission of confidential information;
paras.zh: （7）规定规范保密信息交换和提交的保护令；

paras.en: providing for the filing by the patent owner of a response to the petition under section 323 after a post-grant review has been instituted, and requiring that the patent owner file with such response, through affidavits or declarations, any additional factual evidence and expert opinions on which the patent owner relies in support of the response;
paras.zh: （8）规定在授权后复审启动后，由专利所有人对依第 323 条提交的请求书提交答复，并要求专利所有人在提交答复时，以宣誓书或者声明的方式提交其在答复中所依据的任何补充事实证据和专家意见；

paras.en: setting forth standards and procedures for allowing the patent owner to move to amend the patent under subsection (d) to cancel a challenged claim or propose a reasonable number of substitute claims, and ensuring that any information submitted by the patent owner in support of any amendment entered under subsection (d) is made available to the public as part of the prosecution history of the patent;
paras.zh: （9）规定允许专利所有人依第（d）款申请修改专利、以删除受到挑战的权利要求或者提出合理数量的替代权利要求的标准和程序，并确保专利所有人为支持依第（d）款作出的修改而提交的任何信息，作为专利审查历史的一部分向公众公开；

paras.en: providing either party with the right to an oral hearing as part of the proceeding;
paras.zh: （10）规定任何一方当事人都有权在程序中要求口头审理；
