paras.en: requiring that the final determination in any post-grant review be issued not later than 1 year after the date on which the Director notices the institution of a proceeding under this chapter, except that the Director may, for good cause shown, extend the 1-year period by not more than 6 months, and may adjust the time periods in this paragraph in the case of joinder under section 325(c); and
paras.zh: （11）要求任何授权后复审的最终决定，不晚于局长通知启动本章规定的程序之日起 1 年作出；但局长有正当理由的，可以将 1 年期限延长不超过 6 个月，并可以在依第 325 条（c）款合并的情况下调整本项规定的期限；以及

paras.en: providing the petitioner with at least 1 opportunity to file written comments within a time period established by the Director.
paras.zh: （12）规定请求人在局长确定的期限内至少有 1 次提交书面意见的机会。

paras.en: Considerations.— In prescribing regulations under this section, the Director shall consider the effect of any such regulation on the economy, the integrity of the patent system, the efficient administration of the Office, and the ability of the Office to timely complete proceedings instituted under this chapter.
paras.zh: （b）考虑因素。——局长依本条制定规章时，应当考虑该规章对经济、专利制度的完整性、专利商标局的有效管理，以及专利商标局按时完成依本章启动的程序的能力的影响。

paras.en: Patent Trial and Appeal Board.— The Patent Trial and Appeal Board shall, in accordance with section 6, conduct each post-grant review instituted under this chapter.
paras.zh: （c）专利审判和上诉委员会。——专利审判和上诉委员会应当依照第 6 条，审理依本章启动的每一件授权后复审。

paras.en: Amendment of the Patent.—
paras.zh: （d）专利的修改。——

paras.en: In general.— During a post-grant review instituted under this chapter, the patent owner may file 1 motion to amend the patent in 1 or more of the following ways:
paras.zh: （1）总则。——在依本章启动的授权后复审期间，专利所有人可以提出 1 项修改专利的动议，以下列一种或者多种方式修改专利：

paras.en: Cancel any challenged patent claim.
paras.zh: （A）删除任何受到挑战的专利权利要求。

paras.en: For each challenged claim, propose a reasonable number of substitute claims.
paras.zh: （B）对每一项受到挑战的权利要求，提出合理数量的替代权利要求。

paras.en: Additional motions.— Additional motions to amend may be permitted upon the joint request of the petitioner and the patent owner to materially advance the settlement of a proceeding under section 327, or upon the request of the patent owner for good cause shown.
paras.zh: （2）追加动议。——为实质性推进依第 327 条进行的程序和解，经请求人和专利所有人共同请求，或者经专利所有人请求并证明有正当理由，可以准许追加修改动议。

paras.en: Scope of claims.— An amendment under this subsection may not enlarge the scope of the claims of the patent or introduce new matter.
paras.zh: （3）权利要求的范围。——依本款作出的修改，不得扩大专利权利要求的范围，也不得引入新的内容。

paras.en: Evidentiary Standards.— In a post-grant review instituted under this chapter, the petitioner shall have the burden of proving a proposition of unpatentability by a preponderance of the evidence.
paras.zh: （e）证明标准。——在依本章启动的授权后复审中，请求人对不具备可专利性的主张负有以优势证据加以证明的责任。

units.title: Settlement
units.group: 第 32 章 授权后复审（PGR）

paras.en: In General.— A post-grant review instituted under this chapter shall be terminated with respect to any petitioner upon the joint request of the petitioner and the patent owner, unless the Office has decided the merits of the proceeding before the request for termination is filed. If the post-grant review is terminated with respect to a petitioner under this section, no estoppel under section 325(e) shall attach to the petitioner, or to the real party in interest or privy of the petitioner, on the basis of that petitioner’s institution of that post-grant review. If no petitioner remains in the post-grant review, the Office may terminate the post-grant review or proceed to a final written decision under section 328(a).
paras.zh: （a）总则。——经请求人和专利所有人共同请求，依本章启动的授权后复审对该请求人终止；但专利商标局在提出终止请求前已就程序实体问题作出决定的除外。依本条对某一请求人终止授权后复审的，不因该请求人启动了该授权后复审，而对该请求人或者其实际利益方、利害关系人适用第 325 条（e）款规定的禁止反悔。授权后复审中已无请求人的，专利商标局可以终止授权后复审，也可以继续作出第 328 条（a）款规定的最终书面决定。

paras.en: Agreements in Writing.— Any agreement or understanding between the patent owner and a petitioner, including any collateral agreements referred to in such agreement or understanding, made in connection with, or in contemplation of, the termination of a post-grant review under this section shall be in writing, and a true copy of such agreement or understanding shall be filed in the Office before the termination of the post-grant review as between the parties. At the request of a party to the proceeding, the agreement or understanding shall be treated as business confidential information, shall be kept separate from the file of the involved patents, and shall be made available only to Federal Government agencies on written request, or to any person on a showing of good cause.
paras.zh: （b）书面协议。——专利所有人与请求人之间就依本条终止授权后复审达成的、或者为此而达成的任何协议或者谅解（包括其中提及的任何附属协议），应当采用书面形式，并应当在当事人之间的授权后复审终止前，将该协议或者谅解的真实副本提交专利商标局。经程序一方当事人请求，该协议或者谅解应当作为商业秘密信息处理，与所涉专利的案卷分开保存，并且只有在联邦政府机构书面请求时，或者任何人证明有正当理由时，才向其提供。

units.title: Decision of the Board
units.group: 第 32 章 授权后复审（PGR）

paras.en: Final Written Decision.— If a post-grant review is instituted and not dismissed under this chapter, the Patent Trial and Appeal Board shall issue a final written decision with respect to the patentability of any patent claim challenged by the petitioner and any new claim added under section 326(d).
paras.zh: （a）最终书面决定。——依本章启动且未被驳回的授权后复审，专利审判和上诉委员会应当就请求人挑战的任何专利权利要求以及依第 326 条（d）款新增的任何权利要求的可专利性，作出最终书面决定。

paras.en: Certificate.— If the Patent Trial and Appeal Board issues a final written decision under subsection (a) and the time for appeal has expired or any appeal has terminated, the Director shall issue and publish a certificate canceling any claim of the patent finally determined to be unpatentable, confirming any claim of the patent determined to be patentable, and incorporating in the patent by operation of the certificate any new or amended claim determined to be patentable.
paras.zh: （b）证书。——专利审判和上诉委员会依第（a）款作出最终书面决定，且上诉期限已经届满或者任何上诉已经终结的，局长应当签发并公布证书，撤销专利中最终被认定不具备可专利性的任何权利要求，确认被认定具备可专利性的任何权利要求，并通过该证书的效力将被认定具备可专利性的任何新的或者经修改的权利要求并入专利。

paras.en: Intervening Rights.— Any proposed amended or new claim determined to be patentable and incorporated into a patent following a post-grant review under this chapter shall have the same effect as that specified in section 252 for reissued patents on the right of any person who made, purchased, or used within the United States, or imported into the United States, anything patented by such proposed amended or new claim, or who made substantial preparation therefor, before the issuance of a certificate under subsection (b).
paras.zh: （c）中间权利。——在依本章进行的授权后复审后被认定具备可专利性并并入专利的任何拟修改或者新增的权利要求，对于在依第（b）款签发证书之前，在美国境内制造、购买或者使用，或者向美国进口该拟修改或者新增权利要求所保护的任何物品，或者为此作好实质性准备的任何人的权利，具有第 252 条就再颁专利所规定的同等效力。

paras.en: Data on Length of Review.— The Office shall make available to the public data describing the length of time between the institution of, and the issuance of a final written decision under subsection (a) for, each post-grant review.
paras.zh: （d）复审时长数据。——专利商标局应当向公众公开数据，说明每一件授权后复审从启动到依第（a）款作出最终书面决定之间的时长。

units.source: (Added and amended Pub. L. 112–29, §§ 6(d), 20(j), Sept. 16, 2011, 125 Stat. 310, 335.)

units.title: Appeal
units.group: 第 32 章 授权后复审（PGR）

paras.en: A party dissatisfied with the final written decision of the Patent Trial and Appeal Board under section 328(a) may appeal the decision pursuant to sections 141 through 144. Any party to the post-grant review shall have the right to be a party to the appeal.
paras.zh: 对专利审判和上诉委员会依第 328 条（a）款作出的最终书面决定不服的当事人，可以依第 141 条至第 144 条对该决定提起上诉。授权后复审的任何当事人都有权成为该上诉的当事人。

units.title: Appeal to Court of Appeals for the Federal Circuit
units.group: 上诉

paras.en: Examinations.— An applicant who is dissatisfied with the final decision in an appeal to the Patent Trial and Appeal Board under section 134(a) may appeal the Board’s decision to the United States Court of Appeals for the Federal Circuit. By filing such an appeal, the applicant waives his or her right to proceed under section 145.
paras.zh: （a）审查。——申请人对依第 134 条（a）款向专利审判和上诉委员会（PTAB）提出上诉后作出的最终决定不服的，可以就该委员会的决定向美国联邦巡回上诉法院上诉。申请人提出此类上诉的，即放弃依第 145 条起诉的权利。

paras.en: Reexaminations.— A patent owner who is dissatisfied with the final decision in an appeal of a reexamination to the Patent Trial and Appeal Board under section 134(b) may appeal the Board’s decision only to the United States Court of Appeals for the Federal Circuit.
paras.zh: （b）再审查。——专利所有人对依第 134 条（b）款就再审查向专利审判和上诉委员会提出上诉后作出的最终决定不服的，只能就该委员会的决定向美国联邦巡回上诉法院上诉。

paras.en: Post-Grant and Inter Partes Reviews.— A party to an inter partes review or a post-grant review who is dissatisfied with the final written decision of the Patent Trial and Appeal Board under section 318(a) or 328(a) (as the case may be) may appeal the Board’s decision only to the United States Court of Appeals for the Federal Circuit.
paras.zh: （c）授权后复审和多方复审。——多方复审（IPR）或者授权后复审（PGR）的当事人，对专利审判和上诉委员会依第 318 条（a）款或者第 328 条（a）款（视情况而定）作出的最终书面决定不服的，只能就该委员会的决定向美国联邦巡回上诉法院上诉。

paras.en: Derivation Proceedings.— A party to a derivation proceeding who is dissatisfied with the final decision of the Patent Trial and Appeal Board in the proceeding may appeal the decision to the United States Court of Appeals for the Federal Circuit, but such appeal shall be dismissed if any adverse party to such derivation proceeding, within 20 days after the appellant has filed notice of appeal in accordance with section 142, files notice with the Director that the party elects to have all further proceedings conducted as provided in section 146. If the appellant does not, within 30 days after the filing of such notice by the adverse party, file a civil action under section 146, the Board’s decision shall govern the further proceedings in the case.
paras.zh: （d）来源程序。——来源程序的当事人对专利审判和上诉委员会在该程序中作出的最终决定不服的，可以向美国联邦巡回上诉法院上诉；但是，如果该来源程序的任何对方当事人在上诉人依第 142 条提交上诉通知后 20 日内，向局长提交通知选择依第 146 条进行后续全部程序，该上诉应予驳回。对方当事人提交该通知后 30 日内，上诉人未依第 146 条提起民事诉讼的，委员会的决定对本案后续程序具有约束力。

paras.en: (iii) If the applicant made a certification described in subclause (IV) of paragraph (2)(A)(vii), the approval shall be made effective immediately unless, before the expiration of 45 days after the date on which the notice described in paragraph (2)(B) is received, an action is brought for infringement of the patent that is the subject of the certification and for which information was submitted to the Secretary under subsection (b)(1) or (c)(2) before the date on which the application (excluding an amendment or supplement to the application), which the Secretary later determines to be substantially complete, was submitted. explain.en: Paragraph IV is the generic applicant’s challenge to a listed patent. Suing within 45 days triggers the 30-month stay; the exceptions after “except that—” (court decisions within the period) are omitted here.
explain.zh: 第四段声明是仿制药申请人对登记专利的挑战。专利权人在 45 日内起诉，就触发 30 个月的等待期。“except that——”之后的例外情形（等待期内法院作出判决等）这里没有收录。
